dns.note: Gateway subdomain behind Cloudflare; not a user-owned apex domain. *.tapekit.org is the TapeKit gateway, so no user DNS record exists to audit.

tls.note: Validated twice (openssl-independent Node client, authorized=true). An earlier run failed with a socket disconnect; re-running succeeded, so that was transient network, not a certificate problem.

content.note: The raw HTTP body is the gateway's service-worker bootstrap (by design). After the SW takes over it fetches the container's bytes from chain; those bytes match the on-chain declared SHA-256 exactly.

negativeControl.message: Cannot display / This processor has no such circuit
negativeControl.note: Proves the 200 above is conditional on the name being real and activated.

residual: The harness's own gateway command reports BLOCKED on http.contentHash because it hashes the bootstrap page; the service-worker fetch above is the authoritative check.
